title: rhinanthus glaber var. serotinus
intro: Rhinanthus glaber var. serotinus, commonly known as Late Flowering Yellow Rampion, is a perennial plant species within the Orobanchaceae family, characterized by its unique yellow flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestion and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which work to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Rhinanthus glaber var. serotinus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
